turns.content: Tobbe is rummaging through the supply wagon, looking distressed. I walk over. "What's wrong, big man?"

Tobbe: "Salt is gone. Whole sack. Tobbe packed it himself."
Brennic: *from his seat on a barrel* "Wasn't me. I prefer my thieving to pay better."
Mira: "I recall seeing it this morning beside the water casks, and I remember because it was leaking a little, leaving a white line in the grass."
I follow the faint white trail around the back of the wagon. "Mira, you might have just solved this."

The trail of salt leads into the brush, where a pair of goats is happily licking the torn sack.
Tobbe: *puts both hands on his head, over the carp tattoo* "Goats! Little thieves."
Brennic: *laughs, a short dry bark* "Smugglers. Respect. Clean work."
Mira: "Goats are known to seek salt, and I believe Halvard mentions it in his notes on hill farms."
I scoop up what's left of the sack. "Half of it's still good. Will it do for supper?"

Tobbe: *weighs it in his palm, humming* "Half is enough. Tobbe will cook careful." *pats a goat's head* "No more for you."
Brennic: "Tie the sack higher next time. Or hire a goat guard, eh, friend?"
Mira: "I would like it noted that I found the trail, and I have noted it myself, in case anyone forgets."
